translation.name: Ala wene Nggem enane vaga dirup warek

book.name: Lukas
book.title: Lukas Sek wene Lukas en dirup watigi

content: Yesus wolok Pilatus adema lagagwa wene
It Yakuri enawene amburup mbalisagwi menda anderogo yugu lagagwarik, avakwa homago ako ovok erogo mendek yiluk, Yesus vakbaluk Gubernur Pilatus
adema wolok lagagwa.

Wolok lagu lagagwarik, enane huluk ova-ova yugu dugwit, “Ap yi, nit avakwa ovok nenavut dagalit lagya dugwit, ‘Ap inis ombok Kaisar o vagago agarik onggo yoparip wogorup moga o. Henasin inis ombok Keretus An aro,’ yagan lagyama, heyakbagyo.”
Yugugu lagagwama, at Pilatus en Yesus yugugu dugwit, “Ap Yakuri enasin inis ombok hat at ai?” Yugugu lagagimu, At Yesus en, “Yegen andi aro.”

Yugugu lagagimu, at Pilatus en it ap imam-imam enasini inim, avakwa wisane homago ako inim, yugirigya dugwit, “Ap yi, at avyarat weyak ogaga halok andi, At warup sek ovara, At ogaga ambi an mondok nil hegetek.”

Yugeragagi ovara, it enane vanggo erogo hunik adigat yugu dugwit, “Dek. Ap yi, wene mamuleregek lagya dugwit, avakwa o Yudea menda ovok erogo o Nggaliliya en o yi hudi at enavut dagalit landiga,” yiluk, yugogogwa.
Yesus Herodes adema lakbagagi wene
Yugugwis ako at Pilatus aruk hunggu lagagirik, “At ap yi, Nggaliliya menda ai?” yiluk, avakwa yugirigya lagagimu,
“Yu,” yugogogwa. Yugugu lagagwama, Pilatus en ap inis ombok Herodes o Nggaliliya vagago agarik yiluk, O Yerusalem sidok wagagirik werekma, aren Yesus owak dilupwak yiluk, adema lakbagagi.

Lakbagagi lagya lagagimu, ap Herodes ako en Yesus ogarit lagya aruk hunggu lagagirik, “Enelup arup enalon werek menda ambi ogagya haik en ai,” o muk en hogop imbita lagagima, Yesus higya lagagirik, endawi adenggen imbitigi.
Endawi adenggen imbita lagagirik, yi wene ndi wene wisane Yesus hemethagagi ovara, Yesus wene onggo yegetek mbup erek welagagi.
Mbup erek werekma, it imam-imam enasini inim, it ap Musa wene mbalek mamulerelagwi menda inim, huluk ova-ova yugu dugwit At ovaga bagu lagagwa.

Eke, at Herodes arwi yegen werek menda inim Yesus wiyiknom-weyaknom erogo bagu dugwit, aganda yagagwa. Andi ovok okbagu lagagwarik, yum mondok segedok menda yikbaluk, eyami vaga Pilatus adema lakba lagagi.
At Herodes Pilatus endak iperen ogorek welagagwa ovara, andi hudi iperen dambulagagwa.
“Yesus mondok warusogom,” yagagwa wene
Yesus eyami vaga lakba wagagirikmu, at Pilatus en it ap imam-imam enasini inim, Yakuri ap ombok-ombok inim, avakwa ugun inim, homakbugu lagagirik,

yugirigya dugwit, “Ap yi, avakwa enavut dagalit landiga yiluk, nadema wolok wagep ovara, henane At ovaga bagep ako, hinivaga owak dinggirikmu, at weyak ogaga halok andi at warup sek ovara, At weyak ogaga ambi an mondok hegetek.
Eke, Herodes ogo, At weyak ambi ogagatek higya lagarik, eyami vaga lakba wagama, weyak ogagu-selok, enasagwi ovara, At weyak ambi mondok ogagetek o, yiluk, yukheraliga.
Anderogoma, asam hapwak yiluk, yo adigat warogo hekbayogon,” yiluk, yugeragagi.
[Yugeragagi ako, Isogo Vasika isagu-selok, ap heda mago ambi visilogo hekbagek ogagya lagagima, yiluk, yugeragagi.]
Wene ako yugirigya lagagimu, it ovok ambivaga yugu dugwit, “A! Ap yi warogo bas. Ap Mbarabas visilogo hekbininin,” yugogogwa.
Ap Mbarabas ako avakwa nin inim en, “Nenadik dogosogom,” yiluk, o kota andoma ndup ogagu dugwit, ap ambi watya lagagimu, heda magogo mabiselagwima mabagagwa werekma, yugogogwa.
Yugugu lagagwama, at Pilatus en Yesus hekbaup imbita dugwit, ane mberen vaga it yugeragagi ovara,
enane yanjak-hanjak yugu dugwit, “At yo winik vaga lobalogo watbas. Yo winik lobalogo watbas.”

Yugu lagagwama, at Pilatus en ane henggam vaga ambi inim yugirigya dugwit, “Nggarogo yiluk? At weyak ogaga ngga vaga yegep? Weyak ogagu-selok enasagwi ovara, weyak ogaga eve ngga halok, ‘Warup,’ yagalagwi? At weyak ogaga ambi, an hegetekma, un asam hapwak yiluk yo warogo hekbayogon.”
Yugeragagi ovara, yo winik vaga lobalogo baupwak yiluk, enane hunik adigat yanjak-hanjak yugu dugwit, Pilatus ane ako sagalogo bagu lagagwama,
at okbaup yugogogwa ako Pilatus en anggon imbita dugwit ovara, “Sek aro,” yiluk, yugeragagi.

Yugirigya lagagimu, at ap, “Nenadik dogosogom,” yiluk, ndup ogagya dugwit, ap watya lagagimu, heda magogo mabiselagwima mabagagwa ako, “Visilogo hekbininin,” yugogogwa ako visilogo wibagagi ovara, Yesus andi, it umbutugwa ako ndatak okbamwak yiluk, wogeragagi.
Yesus yo winik vaga lobabagagwa wene

Wogorigya lagagimu, vagakluk lagu dugwit, ap ambi inis Simon awi Kirene mendama, weram en endawi ugun o kota akoma nunggu wagyama, vagarogo yo winik ako Yesus ambetaga wolok laupwak yiluk, omado vaga bagagwa.
It avakwa wisane at amusek lagu dugwit, akwa nin en ayup yagwi, eneyave wakhidugwi, ogarit inim lagagwa.
Ogarit lagusim, At Yesus elokwe endenogo biginigu lagagirik, it yugirigya dugwit, “Hit akwa O Yerusalem menda yi, An nayup yarubuk. Ata, hit heneyagi hinim henayup yakhidugu dogones.

[Anggin henovaga arisogonma,] it avakwa en yugu dugwit, ‘Akwa wimbu inim, eneyak betelagudek inim, enagadyak wogorugwi ininggut inim, enadenggen ombasagwi o,’ yiluk, yugu dogop hudi wasogon, yukheraliga.
Andi hudi it avakwa en ndom ombok yugugu dugwit, ‘Endenogo sopalogo bininin o,’ yiluk, yugugwis, eke, ndom maduk yugugu dugwit, ‘Neneyave sovalogo bininin o,’ yiluk, yugugwis,
ogarusogom.
Andi, avakwa en yo iluk hegek anderogo okbagu-selok, yo mbuk agya halok, nggarogo okbaup embetep?” yiluk yugeragagi.
Yesus vagakluk lagu dugwit, it ap weyak ogasagwi menda eneyave mberen Yesus inim enaruguluk, vaginiviluk lagagwa.

Vaginiviluk o inis Unggul Owakma akoma lagu lagagwarik, At Yesus it ap weyak ogasagwi ako inim yo winik vaga lobalogo bugu dugwit, ambi inggis amot vikit bagwi, ambi inggis hware vikit bagwi, ogarogo bogogwa.

Lobalogo bugu lagagwama, At Yesus en, “Ai Nasin o. It ininggut dugwit, obanilagwima, it weyak ogasagwi yi, enomaduk dek erogo bisin o,” yugogogi. Eke, it ap ako en helep enggen vaga wakhegek ogagu dugwit, asum sumbukhedagagwa.

It avakwa ako andenam inil vurek werekma, it ap Yakuri enasini ako en At wiyiknom-weyaknom erogo bagu dugwit, “At avakwa enagap wendatya lagama, At Ala en denogo mondok okbagagi Keretus ako avyarat halok andi, agap wendakhedapwak,” yiluk, yagagwa.
Eke, it ap yegen werek menda ako ogo, At aganda yagu dugwit, anggur amburup eda menda At situn okhagagwa.
Situn okhugu dugwit, “Hat ap Yakuri enasin hinis ombok halok andi, hagap wendakhedoman!” yiluk, yugogogwa.
Eke, wene ambi, “Yakuri enasin inis ombok yi aro,” yiluk, dirup warogo unggumu yo winik vaga lobabagagwa.

Lobabaluk werekma, ap mberen inim lobalogo bogogwa ako ap ambi en At Yesus wiyiknom-weyaknom erogo bagya dugwit, “Ala en denogo mondok okbagagi Keretus harat ako dek? Harat halok andi, hat hagap wendakhidigya, eke, nit nenagap wendatya, ogaru.”
Yugogogi ovara, aswe ako en at mberugu dugwit, “At ovaga lobalogo baup embetao ndatak hat ogo wane-wane hovaga lobalogo bagagaoma, hat Ala halon embetetek yi?
Nit okbininalagwi ako andi, ogagyo onggo ndatak okbininalagwima, sek at ovara, at yi andi, weyak mondok ogagetek o.”
Yugugu lagagirik, Yesus yugugu dugwit, “Ai, Nasin Yesus. Hinis ombok akluk wagya halok, An vaga hendawi wenggenerano.”
Yugugu lagagimu, At Yesus en at yugugu dugwit, “Yogak hambuluk, landagwima o mondok segedokma akoma hat niperen dogosogom o, yiluk, avyarat yukhisiga o,” yugogogi.
Yesus hombagagi wene

Eke, o dingga yam 12 vaga yi awi ndi awi andoma, mo il awia mondok dek agya lagagimu, o hup hak agagi hegek, mbikit yam 3 howam vaga o awiya agagi. Eke, Ala awi valekma yum obak ilim sivinik welagagi ako, ilim wane erogo nggago yagagi.
Nggago iri lagagimu, At Yesus ane ombok vaga iri dugwit, “Ai Nasin o. Nendawi Hat hinggimu dogonyok yiluk, wokhisiga o,” yiluk, endawi weralhidigya lagagirik, hombagagi.
At yegen werek enasin ako en ogagya higya lagagirik, at Ala inis siyabagya dugwit, “Ap yi, at avyarat weyak ogagatek higi o,” yiluk, yagagi.
Eke, it avakwa wisane inil dogoguluk, wonggalari lagagwa ako ogagwi hugu lagagwarik, eneyave wakhedegek eneyami vaga suguliluk enamwa wunggugwa.
Eke, At Yesus inim hunik ako, it akwa o Nggaliliya en at inim wagagwa ako inim, o adumu en andenam mendek dugwit, ogagwi ako ovok erogo inil lakhagagwa.
Yesus eyave wimu mabagagwa wene

O Yudea kota ambi inis Arimatea andoma ap ambi inis Yusup welagagi. At ap andi it Yakuri enawene amburup mbalisiga ako menda welagagi ovara, aswei wene amburup mbalisagwi menda ako en, “Yesus watbaup,” hobaluk ogagagwa ako at endawi sek atma nggedok ogasiga mendama, at ane inim mondok lobanggitek. Eke, aren “Ala avema bininapwak o,” yiluk, sokhigya lagagi.
At ap ako en Pilatus adema lagya lagagirik, “Yesus eve warek wokniru o,” yiluk, nggino yugogogi, “E o,” yugugu lagagimu,
eyave warek ako visilogo wombaba wagya lagagirik, yum mudu obak vaga dinggilogo helep wis swi mendagoma avakwa ao mabigitek akoma maba lagagi.
Hutun it Yakuri samban ogarup yiluk, vipuk erogo bagwi ako vaga ogagagi.
Eke, it akwa Yesus inim o Nggaliliya en wagagwa ako Yusup amusek lagu lagagwarik, wimu mendago inim, Yesus eyave welalogo bagagwa inim, inil hagagwa.

Inil helok, eneyami vaga enamwa wunggu lagagwarik, yo enggen amburup sek menda inim, amburup amben segedok menda inim, vipuk erogo bagagwa. Vipuk erogo bagu lagagwarik, Ala en, “Yerogo ogarup, nderogo ogarup,” yagagi dirup mbalek ako ndatak it Yakuri samban ogasagwi vaga [wolok lagatek] sat yanggal hedagagwa.

footnotes.text: At Pilatus ako o propinsi Yudea Gubernur vagago welagagi.

Adem ayat yi, yo iluk andi Yesus, at weyak ogagatek. Eke yo mbuk andi, avakwa weyak ogasagwi menda. Yesus weyak ogagatek ovara edup-mbedup okbagagwa halok, it weyak ogasagwi menda nggarogo okbaup ombasagwi? It evenuk weyak okbugugu dogosogom.
